title: Cartwise Shopper Batches Heavy, Waiting, Boost and Quality Pay Table
content:
Heavy pay, waiting-time pay, the peak boost and the quality bonus of Cartwise Shopper Batches are set per batch type.

## Heavy and waiting-time pay

| Batch type | Heavy units at which heavy pay starts | Heavy pay per heavy unit (USD) | Unpaid waiting (minutes) | Waiting rate (USD per minute) | Waiting pay cap per batch (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Shop-Only Batch | 0 (no heavy pay) | 0.00 | 0 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Express 30 Batch | 3 | 0.50 | 10 | 0.20 | 5.00 |
| Single Delivery Batch | 3 | 0.50 | 15 | 0.15 | 6.00 |
| Double Delivery Batch | 3 | 0.50 | 15 | 0.15 | 6.00 |
| Triple Delivery Batch | 3 | 0.50 | 15 | 0.15 | 6.00 |
| Stock-Up Batch | 1 | 0.75 | 20 | 0.20 | 8.00 |

A heavy-unit starting figure of 0 means the batch type pays no heavy pay. Unpaid waiting is waiting at the store counter or the customer's door that is not paid; recorded waiting beyond it is paid at the waiting rate up to the cap.

## Peak boost and quality bonus

| Batch type | Peak boost shown on the offer is paid | Largest peak boost (USD) | Quality bonus per qualifying order (USD) | Quality bonus rating window (hours after completion) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Shop-Only Batch | Yes | 3.00 | 0.00 | 0 |
| Express 30 Batch | Yes | 5.00 | 0.00 | 0 |
| Single Delivery Batch | Yes | 5.00 | 0.50 | 24 |
| Double Delivery Batch | Yes | 6.00 | 0.50 | 24 |
| Triple Delivery Batch | Yes | 7.00 | 0.50 | 24 |
| Stock-Up Batch | Yes | 10.00 | 1.00 | 48 |

The quality bonus is paid per order rated 5 stars within the rating window with no item refund. The Shop-Only Batch and the Express 30 Batch carry no quality bonus.

## Worked illustration (hypothetical waiting)

On a hypothetical Single Delivery Batch with 55 minutes of recorded waiting, 15 minutes are unpaid, leaving 40 minutes; 40 multiplied by 0.15 is 6.00, which is exactly the 6.00 cap. With 60 minutes recorded, 45 minutes multiplied by 0.15 is 6.75, and the cap holds the waiting pay at 6.00.
